assertions._why: a headless run has no channel to confirm, so Step 5 must degrade to report-only: every planted finding is reported and nothing is edited. Scratch claims/snapshot files go to the OS temp dir, so even a stray write into the fixture fails here. The edit-applying variant is parked in cases/pending/ until headless pre-approval is decided.
this skill never commits -- HEAD must stay on the last fixture-history commit.

the report must name the finding kinds; the fixture plants certain POINTER findings (a present-but-gitignored plan, an absent plan, a TASKS.md row), so a run that stopped before the scan would not print it.
Google, NumPy and Sphinx param drift are planted; THIN in the report proves the docstring checks ran, not just the pointer scan.
triage runs BEFORE the confirmation, so a report-only run still dispatches the triage fan-out; the fixture's models.cap is sonnet and every dispatch must honor it.
nothing was edited, so the fixture's doctest and FastAPI route tests must still pass -- a failure here means the run touched behavior.
